title: Page moves while loading or scrolling (CLS, phone)
fix: See 'Layout shifts' below: it lists the element that moves.
Give images, ads, banners and widgets a fixed size (width/height or aspect-ratio).
Animate only transform and opacity, never width/height/top/margin.
check: Real-visitor CLS 0.1 or less on phone and desktop.

title: Page moves while loading or scrolling (CLS, desktop)
fix: See 'Layout shifts' below: it lists the element that moves.
Give images, ads, banners and widgets a fixed size.
check: Real-visitor CLS 0.1 or less on desktop.

title: Chat widget moves the page
fix: Show your own small chat button with a fixed size and position: fixed.
Load the chat script only when the user clicks that button, then open the chat.
A timer (setTimeout) does not fix it: the shift only happens later.
check: No chat element in 'Layout shifts'.

title: Main content shows late on phones (LCP)
fix: Make the hero image a normal , not a CSS background.
Host fonts and scripts on your own domain and preload the hero font.
Do not hide hero text behind a JavaScript animation.
check: Lighthouse mobile LCP 2.5 s or less.

title: JavaScript blocks the page on phones (TBT)
fix: Remove unused tags from Google Tag Manager.
Load chat, animation and slider scripts only when needed (on click or when the section is near the screen).
check: Lighthouse mobile TBT 200 ms or less.

title: Scripts keep the phone busy after the page loads
fix: See 'Late requests' below for scripts that load after the page.
Load third-party scripts on first click/scroll instead of on a timer, and remove ones you do not need.
check: Real-visitor blocking time 300 ms or less.

title: Page keeps loading things for a long time
fix: Timers (setTimeout) that load GTM, chat or libraries keep the page busy. GTmetrix waits for all of them.
Load them on user interaction or when needed, not on a timer.
check: Network quiet within 8 s (GTmetrix 'Fully Loaded Time' should drop too).

title: Cloudflare does not cache the page
fix: Cloudflare > Caching > Cache Rules: this path = Eligible for cache, Edge TTL 1 hour.
Purge the cache after every deploy.
First check the HTML has no per-user data (form token, UTM values).
check: Header cf-cache-status shows HIT.

title: Server answers slowly (TTFB)
fix: Cache the page on Cloudflare (see cache rule).
Check slow PHP code or database calls on this page.
check: TTFB under 600 ms in all 3 tries (under 200 ms when cached).

title: Server sometimes takes very long to answer
fix: Cache the page on Cloudflare so visitors do not wait for the server (see cache rule).
Ask the hosting (Namecheap) about slow PHP or a busy shared server if it continues.
check: Slowest of 3 tries under 3 s (ads visitors leave if the page is blank that long).

title: Fonts load from another site
fix: Host the font files (woff2) on your own domain.
Preload the font used in the hero.
check: No fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com in 'External files'.

title: Scripts or styles load from a public CDN
fix: Download the file and host it on your own domain, load it with defer.
check: No jsdelivr/unpkg/cdnjs in 'External files'.

title: Images without width and height
fix: Add width and height to every so the browser keeps the space.
check: 0 images without size.

title: Page is heavy
fix: Resize images to the size they are shown (srcset), WebP/AVIF quality 70-75.
Remove unused JavaScript.
check: Page weight under 1500 KB.

title: Real phone visitors see the page jump (Google data)
fix: Fix the layout shift problems in this report first.
Google data is a 28-day average: it improves slowly after the fix.
check: Google phone CLS 0.1 or less (re-check about 4 weeks after the fix).

title: Real phone visitors wait for the main content (Google data)
fix: Fix server speed (cache) and the hero image/fonts first.
check: Google phone LCP 2.5 s or less.

title: Page reacts slowly to taps on phones (INP, Google data)
fix: Remove or delay heavy scripts (GTM tags, chat, sliders).
Keep click handlers short; do heavy work later (setTimeout 0 / requestIdleCallback).
check: Google phone INP 200 ms or less.

title: Ad visitors on phones see the page jump (Cloudflare data, last 7 days)
fix: Fix the layout shift problems in this report first.
check: Cloudflare phone CLS 0.1 or less a few days after the fix.

title: Ad visitors on phones wait for the main content (Cloudflare data)
fix: Fix server speed (cache) and the hero image/fonts first.
check: Cloudflare phone LCP 2.5 s or less.

title: Page reacts slowly to taps for ad visitors (Cloudflare data)
fix: Remove or delay heavy scripts (GTM tags, chat, sliders).
check: Cloudflare phone INP 200 ms or less.

title: GTmetrix performance below 90%
fix: Fix the other problems first, then run the audit again.
check: GTmetrix Grade A, performance 90% or more.
